title: Research Data Center READY.json 1.0
description: Proposed tool-generated completion marker; binds exact manifest bytes, not a lock or proof of immutable content.

submission_id.description: Must equal the allocated submission ID and dedicated staging directory ID.

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of exact manifest.jsonl bytes; must be verified at runtime.

submitted_at.description: Tool-generated timestamp with timezone; retries retain the first submitted marker.
